name: Example office
description: Pennywhistle Paper, Harbour Branch: made-up staff, a receptionist and a seaside colour scheme of teal, slate and sand.

manager.name: Alex Mercer
lines: Let's circle back on that before the all-hands.
Is this a priority or a nice-to-have?
I need that on my desk by end of day, ideally yesterday.
Great work. Can we make it feel more strategic?
Let's take this offline and put it in the deck.
My door is always open, but my calendar is not.

receptionist.name: Odette Marsh
lines: Good morning, Pennywhistle Paper. How may I redirect you?
Take a seat. Someone will be with you in a moment, or an hour.
The visitor pen is out of ink, but it has a lovely weight.
I will put you through. It might ring for a while.
Harbour Branch parcels go on the left. The left is the right shelf.

smallTalk: Did you see the new stapler in the kitchen?
It is very heavy. I think it is a status symbol.
Only if you ask it nicely and do not look at the stairs.
Anyone want a biscuit from the tin?
Only the ones with the chocolate. The others are for the meeting.
The printer is making that noise again.
It is not broken, it is just thinking about its life choices.
Have you tried the new coffee machine?
It asks me how I feel every morning. I have no answer yet.
Whose umbrella is by the window?
I think it has been there since the spring offsite.
Is the meeting room booked for three?
It is, but only for a meeting about booking meeting rooms.
Did the plant on the windowsill survive the weekend?
Barely. It has a new name now: Quarterly Review.

staff.name: Dana Whitcombe
lines: The biscuit budget is confidential, so please stop asking.
Who ate the last of the oat bars? I am not angry, just disappointed.
Fruit is also a snack. I checked.

staff.name: Marta Quill
lines: Turn it off and on again. That is the whole secret.
It only jams when it senses fear.
I have named the scanner. Its name is Gerald.

staff.name: Bert Lindqvist
lines: Staples are a finite resource. Use them wisely.
Four-across is seven letters, and I will not discuss it.

staff.name: Hana Oduya
lines: Room 3 is booked, but Room 4 has a lovely view of the car park.
Please vacate the small room before the big room needs it.
Your calendar invite said optional. It was not optional.
I can fit you in at 4:15, or possibly 4:20.

staff.name: Gus Ferreira
lines: Decaf is not coffee. I will hear no arguments.
The machine has been escalated to the machine's manager.
Oat milk is a lifestyle, and I respect it.

staff.name: Noor Haddad
lines: I found a recurring meeting from 2019. Nobody has been since.
This invite has three reschedules and a mystery attendee.
Let me dig through the old threads and find out who started this.

staff.name: Teo Brannigan
lines: The stationery cupboard key is on the hook behind the other hook.
I knitted a tea cosy for the printer. It refuses to comment.

staff.name: Iris Kowalczyk
lines: Let's keep this conversation friendly and fully documented.
I have reviewed your thumbs-up and found it lacking in enthusiasm.
